decisions.reason: The source decision concerns optional population of two connectors on the legacy main board, not the contents or completeness of the sensor-board BOM.
This candidate governs power-board BOM readiness, while the source decision is explicitly limited to connector population in the legacy main-board BOM.
Allowing two ESP32-adjacent connectors to remain unpopulated in an order does not change the defined interboard connector types, pinouts, roles, or power chain.
The source changes assembly population status, not connector footprint positioning, orientation, accessibility, or alignment between the main and sensor boards.
Optional connector population does not change the required 70 by 50 mm board dimensions.
The connector-population decision has no effect on the required four-layer stack.
The source does not identify I2C pull-ups or series resistors and does not alter their values, topology, location, or population policy.
The source does not identify either optional connector as a panel-control connector and therefore does not alter the required control-connector inventory.
The decision is limited to connectors on the legacy main board and does not change the sensor-board fanout inventory or connector count.
The source does not identify the charge-status connector or circuit and does not change any charge-status interface requirement.
Optional population in the legacy main-board BOM does not change the required sensor-board fabrication and placement exports.
Whether two connectors are populated during assembly does not change the requirement to provide connector pin markings on the PCB.
